author: 3DPrinting.com
description: Tripo AI has launched Agentic Canvas, a node-based workspace inside Tripo Studio where an AI agent assembles multi-step 3D workflows that users can inspect, edit and run again on other assets. Generative 3D has mostly worked one model at a time. Type a prompt or upload a picture, get a mesh, then do it again […]
title: Tripo AI Launches Agentic Canvas, a Node-Based Workflow Builder for AI 3D

author: 3DPrinting.com
description: Northwestern's slot-die and light process builds freestanding lattices from paste inks over four times faster than extrusion, without co-printed supports.
title: Northwestern Engineers Print Paste Inks Into Freestanding Lattices Four Times Faster
